key_events: I've traveled all over the known world. This village is a good, quiet place to do business, but it's a bit of a backwater.
The trade routes are getting more dangerous. Those bandits led by Rook are costing me a lot of coin. Someone ought to do something about them.
I avoid the Blacksmith (Baelor). He's too proud and never buys anything. He just scowls at my imported goods.
The Herbalist (Elara) is an odd one, but she sometimes trades rare plants that fetch a high price in the city.
